scope: One bounded read-only review requested by implementation owner. Source/formula/units/charge mapping/partial-network ownership, without new tests or native execution.
conclusion: No concrete physical formula, unit, charge-direction, source-owner or declared-scope mismatch found in the reviewed frozen source.
reasoned_checks: VF Eq4 parameters match the selected author rows. N denotes formed electron count; for Z=4, initial charge=5-N and final charge=4-N. The three array channels are q2->1, q3->2, q4->3.

The coefficient calculation retains a/[sqrt(T/T0)(1+sqrt(T/T0))^(1-b)(1+sqrt(T/T1))^(1+b)] and the declared low-Z 3..1e9 K domain. The 1e4 K log-domain reference difference is binary64 evaluator roundoff, separated from the exact-decimal model and fit error.
Proper densities ne and ni in m^-3 multiply alpha_cm3_s*1e-6, giving events in m^-3 s^-1. A-weighted mass counts use A=7 or9; nuclear charge uses Z=4; ionic charge uses electronic q.

Every positive RR event subtracts one parent, adds one child, and consumes one free electron. Thus each isotope nuclei count and A-weighted baryon count are conserved by this contribution; d(ionic charge minus free electron density)=0 in exact arithmetic.
BeI formation is typed MissingSource rather than a structural zero. Arrays cover q1..4 and only the selected three-channel contribution; they are not a complete electronic or nuclear network.

Be7 and Be9 are explicit caller-supplied labels with ElementalElectronicEquality and isotope_resolved_coefficients=false. Nuclear evolution is explicitly NOT_MODELED_BY_ELECTRONIC_PROVIDER; no decay, electron-capture or daughter model is asserted.

Private prepared bundle fields and exact temperature bits plus fixed source/evaluator/node-count binding prevent a table/direct or temperature mismatch in the supported consumer API. The source rows and grid bounds are fixed by construction.

The Li wrapper compiles the manifest-identical donor module; it keeps the original complete-bundle temperature intersection, channel-specific donor entry points, structural boundaries and explicit Li6/Li7 equality policy. Li8/Li9 remain pending nuclear closure.

Total RR number coefficients do not supply recombination energy moments. No temperature, photon, abundance, decay, full gas feedback, production registry activation or isotope-specific experimental rate is introduced by these modules.
limitations: Static byte/formula review does not certify all binary64 rounding or table error over a continuum.
Producer validation02 tests and finite scan are separate executions by the implementation owner, read as evidence here. This review did not rerun them.

A trace-species contribution needs caller-owned global charge/electron accounting and thermal/nuclear/source closure before full integration. The present three-channel module is intentionally partial.
